data.name: Rhythm Stones
data.detailed_description:
Collaboration

Rhythm Stones has a collaboration with A Dance of Fire and Ice.

Check out the collaboration song in Rhythm Stones!


About the Game

Rhythm Stones is a 1 button 3D rhythm game that crosses moving stepping stones.


1. Cross the 3D stepping stones to the beat!

Rhythm Stones is a 3D rhythm game in which you cross the moving stepping stones to the beat. The stepping stones move in various types of 3D space; flat, cylindrical, spherical, and random!




2. Simple controls, but hardcore difficulty!

Rhythm Stones lets you press any key to play, but can you get past all of the difficult beats until the end?




3. But even if you fail, special items allow you to succeed over time!

The more you lose a level, the more health-increasing items appear. No matter how difficult the stage is, if you keep trying you will surely succeed!




4. Enjoy 56 songs in various genres!

Rhythm Stones consists of 56 stages (including 5 tutorials), and each stage consists of a different song in various genres such as rock, funk, jazz, EDM, acoustic, etc.


※ Game Tip

Rhythm monsters help you know the next beat, so it's very important to memorize each rhythm monster's pattern. In particular, the black rhythm monster (8th note) and the green rhythm monster (quarter note) appear the most!
